have h_main : myMin_postcond (a) (b) (myMin (a) (b) h_precond) h_precond := by
    dsimp [myMin, myMin_precond, myMin_postcond] at *
    <;>
    split_ifs <;>
    (try {
      -- Case 1: a ≤ b
      simp_all [le_refl, le_of_lt]
      <;>
      (try { contradiction }) <;>
      (try { aesop }) <;>
      (try { omega })
    }) <;>
    (try {
      -- Case 2: a > b
      simp_all [le_refl, le_of_lt]
      <;>
      (try { contradiction }) <;>
      (try { aesop }) <;>
      (try { omega })
    }) <;>
    (try {
      -- Common cases
      aesop
    })
    <;>
    (try {
      -- Use omega to handle inequalities
      omega
    })
    <;>
    (try {
      -- Use aesop to handle logical implications
      aesop
    })
  exact h_main
